protocol.note: Same service law and independent streams as EPIC-053. q=h*(c+r) uses known constant costs, not hidden S. Protection resets at each useful start AFTER resume, not on overhead or arrival. Eligible jobs alone may preempt; overhead gate and original prefix retained. Expiries are real review events, not mandatory switches. Protected attempt counters are not saved preemptions. Select h by mean weighted T on separate fully completed tuning traces, ties choose smaller h. Selection frozen before test data are generated; tuned copies one candidate with no extra replay. Censored KM history for EASY is separate from offline tuning traces. Useful lambda is fixed, not renormalized for costs; every mode shares future work/estimates. No I/O/memory/lost work. Latency excludes arrival warmup; time averages exclude drain; counters/resource-time include both. Finite drain/backlog/throughput do not prove stability. Student 95% CIs are conditional on this tuning history, not retraining uncertainty, and have no multiplicity correction. No claimed optimality, real-trace calibration or Slurm emulation.
